dashboard.label: P8 — MITRE ATT&CK Threat Hunting & Detection Operations
dashboard.description: Operational SOC Threat Hunting Dashboard: Hypothesis-driven adversary tracking across Windows Sysmon, Security Event Logs, and Linux audit streams mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Framework.

search.query: (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=windows earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ EventCode IN (4624, 4625, 4672, 4728, 4732, 7045)) OR (index=linux_security earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ "sudo:") | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval is_flagged=case( EventCode=4625, 1, Logon_Type="9", 1, match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|regsvr32|rundll32|-enc|bypass|psexec|whoami|schtasks)"), 1, EventCode IN (4728, 4732, 7045), 1, match(_raw, "(?i)(NOT in sudoers|authentication failure)"), 1, true(), 0 ) | where is_flagged=1 | stats count

(index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=windows earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval tactic=case( EventCode IN (4624, 4625, 4672), "TA0001: Initial Access / TA0008: Lateral", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(powershell|cmd\.exe|wmic)"), "TA0002: Execution", EventCode=7045 OR match(CommandLine, "(?i)(schtasks|reg\s+add)"), "TA0003: Persistence", EventCode IN (4728, 4732) OR match(CommandLine, "(?i)fodhelper"), "TA0004: Privilege Escalation", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|rundll32)"), "TA0005: Defense Evasion", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(whoami|net\s+user|ipconfig)"), "TA0007: Discovery", true(), "Other" ) | where tactic!="Other" | stats dc(tactic) as count

index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval cmd_lower=lower(CommandLine) | where match(cmd_lower, "(?i)powershell.*(-(e|en|enc|encodedcommand)\s+|bypass|downloadstring|iex\b)") | stats count

index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval binary=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | where binary IN ("certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "mshta.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe", "cmstp.exe") | stats count

chart.title: Adversary Activity by MITRE ATT&CK Tactic

search.query: (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=windows earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval tactic=case( EventCode IN (4624, 4625), "TA0001: Initial Access", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(powershell|cmd\.exe|wmic|bash|sh)"), "TA0002: Execution", EventCode=7045 OR match(CommandLine, "(?i)(schtasks|reg\s+add|cron)"), "TA0003: Persistence", EventCode IN (4728, 4732) OR match(CommandLine, "(?i)(fodhelper|sudo)"), "TA0004: Privilege Escalation", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|regsvr32|rundll32)"), "TA0005: Defense Evasion", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(whoami|net\s+user|ipconfig|systeminfo)"), "TA0007: Discovery", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(psexec|paexec|winexe)") OR Logon_Type="10", "TA0008: Lateral Movement", true(), "Other Telemetry" ) | where tactic!="Other Telemetry" | top limit=10 tactic

index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval binary=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | timechart span=1h count by binary limit=8

table.title: Living-Off-The-Land Binaries & Process Masquerading Triage (T1218 / T1036)

search.query: index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='ParentImage'>(?<ParentImage>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='User'>(?<User>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval process_name=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | eval process_path=lower(Image) | eval hunting_finding=case( process_name="certutil.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(-urlcache|-split|-f\s+http)"), "CRITICAL: Certutil Remote Payload Download (T1105)", process_name="bitsadmin.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(/transfer|/addfile)"), "HIGH: Bitsadmin Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105)", process_name="mshta.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(http|vbscript|javascript)"), "CRITICAL: Mshta Remote Script Execution (T1218.005)", process_name="regsvr32.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(/s|/u|/i:http|scrobj.dll)"), "CRITICAL: Regsvr32 Squiblydoo Scriptlet (T1218.010)", process_name="rundll32.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)(javascript|http|dllregisterserver)"), "HIGH: Rundll32 Suspicious Invocation (T1218.011)", process_name="svchost.exe" AND NOT match(process_path, "^c:\\\\windows\\\\system32\\\\svchost\.exe$"), "CRITICAL: Masqueraded svchost.exe outside System32 (T1036.005)", match(process_path, "(?i)\\\\(appdata|temp|programdata)\\\\.*\.exe$"), "SUSPICIOUS: Executable Spawned from Temp/AppData (T1036)", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where hunting_finding!="NORMAL" | stats count as Executions, values(CommandLine) as CommandLine, values(ParentImage) as ParentImage, values(User) as User, latest(_time) as LastSeen by hunting_finding, Image | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - Executions

index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='ParentImage'>(?<ParentImage>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='User'>(?<User>[^<]+)</Data>" | search Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Image="*\\pwsh.exe" | eval cmd_lower=lower(CommandLine) | eval has_enc=if(match(cmd_lower, "(?i)\s+-(e|en|enc|encodedcommand)\s+"), 30, 0) | eval has_bypass=if(match(cmd_lower, "(?i)\s+-(ep|executionpolicy)\s+bypass"), 20, 0) | eval has_hidden=if(match(cmd_lower, "(?i)\s+-(w|windowstyle)\s+hidden"), 20, 0) | eval has_cradle=if(match(cmd_lower, "(?i)(downloadstring|downloaddata|net\.webclient|invoke-webrequest|iwr)"), 25, 0) | eval score=has_enc+has_bypass+has_hidden+has_cradle | eval threat_level=case( score>=60, "CRITICAL", score>=40, "HIGH", score>=20, "MEDIUM", true(), "LOW" ) | where threat_level!="LOW" | table _time, threat_level, score, CommandLine, ParentImage, User | eval _time=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - score

index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$ | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | search EventID=1 | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='ParentImage'>(?<ParentImage>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval child_binary=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | eval parent_binary=lower(replace(ParentImage, ".*\\\\", "")) | where child_binary IN ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe") | eval spawn_anomaly=case( parent_binary IN ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe"), "CRITICAL: Malicious Document Macro Spawning Shell", parent_binary IN ("w3wp.exe", "httpd.exe", "apache2.exe", "nginx.exe"), "CRITICAL: Web Daemon Spawning Command Shell", parent_binary IN ("spoolsv.exe"), "CRITICAL: Print Spooler Spawning Shell (PrintNightmare)", child_binary="cmd.exe" AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)/c\s+(whoami|net\s+user|ipconfig)"), "MEDIUM: Reconnaissance Discovery Burst", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where spawn_anomaly!="NORMAL" | stats count, values(CommandLine) as CommandLine by spawn_anomaly, parent_binary, child_binary | sort - count

(index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=windows EventCode=7045 earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=linux_security "CRON" earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='TargetObject'>(?<TargetObject>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='ServiceName'>(?<ServiceName>[^<]+)</Data>" | eval persist_type=case( EventID IN (12, 13) AND match(TargetObject, "(?i)\\\\(Run|RunOnce|Winlogon)"), "Registry Run/Autostart Key", EventID=1 AND match(CommandLine, "(?i)schtasks.*create"), "Scheduled Task CLI Registration", EventCode=7045, "Windows Service Creation", index="linux_security" AND match(_raw, "(?i)cron"), "Linux Crontab Tampering", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where persist_type!="NORMAL" | stats count, values(CommandLine) as CommandLine, values(TargetObject) as TargetRegistry, values(ServiceName) as ServiceName by persist_type, host | sort - count

table.title: Lateral Movement & Remote Access Triage (T1021 / T1570)

search.query: (index=windows (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=5140) earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) OR (index=sysmon earliest=$time_tok.earliest$ latest=$time_tok.latest$) | rex field=_raw "<EventID>(?<EventID>\d+)</EventID>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='Image'>(?<Image>[^<]+)</Data>" | rex field=_raw "<Data Name='CommandLine'>(?<CommandLine>[^<]*)</Data>" | eval process_name=lower(replace(Image, ".*\\\\", "")) | eval lateral_type=case( process_name IN ("psexesvc.exe", "paexec.exe"), "CRITICAL: PsExec Service Execution", match(CommandLine, "(?i)(psexec|winexe|wmiexec)"), "CRITICAL: Remote Execution CLI Tool", EventCode=4624 AND Logon_Type="10", "HIGH: Remote Interactive RDP Session", EventCode=5140 AND match(ShareName, "(?i)(ADMIN\$|C\$)"), "HIGH: Administrative SMB Share Access", true(), "NORMAL" ) | where lateral_type!="NORMAL" | stats count, values(CommandLine) as CommandLine, values(IpAddress) as SourceIPs by lateral_type, host | sort - count
